verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,

"Tell the people of Israel: Any Israelite, or any foreigner living in Israel, who gives any of his children to the god Molech must be put to death. The people of the land must kill him by throwing stones at him.
I myself will turn against that person and cut him off from his people, because by giving his children to Molech he has made my holy place unclean and dishonoured my holy name.
If the people of the land look the other way when that person gives his children to Molech, and they do not put him to death,
then I myself will turn against that man and his family. I will cut him off from his people, together with everyone who follows him in being unfaithful to me by worshipping Molech.
If anyone turns to people who talk with the dead or to fortune-tellers, and is unfaithful to me by following them, I will turn against that person and cut him off from his people.
So make yourselves holy and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
Keep my rules and obey them. I am the LORD, who makes you holy.
Anyone who curses his father or his mother must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother, so his death is his own fault.
If a man commits adultery with another man's wife, with his neighbour's wife, both the man and the woman must be put to death.
If a man has sexual relations with his father's wife, he has dishonoured his father. Both of them must be put to death. Their death is their own fault.
If a man has sexual relations with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be put to death. They have done a terrible perversion. Their death is their own fault.
If a man has sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman, both of them have done something disgusting. They must be put to death. Their death is their own fault.
If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is evil. He and both women must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no such evil among you.
If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he must be put to death, and you must kill the animal too.
If a woman goes to an animal to have sexual relations with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must be put to death. Their death is their own fault.

If a man marries his sister, the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is shameful. They must be cut off in front of their people. He has dishonoured his sister and must carry the blame.
If a man has sexual relations with a woman during her monthly period, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered it too. Both of them must be cut off from their people.
Do not have sexual relations with your mother's sister or your father's sister. That would dishonour a close relative. Both people must carry the blame.
If a man has sexual relations with his uncle's wife, he has dishonoured his uncle. They will carry the blame for their sin and will die without children.
If a man marries his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing. He has dishonoured his brother. They will have no children.
So keep all my rules and all my laws, and obey them, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not throw you out.
Do not follow the customs of the nation I am driving out ahead of you. They did all these things, and that is why I hated them.
But I have told you, 'You will own their land. I will give it to you as your own, a land flowing with milk and honey.' I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the other nations.

So you must know the difference between clean and unclean animals, and between clean and unclean birds. Do not make yourselves disgusting by eating any animal, bird, or crawling creature that I have set apart as unclean for you.
Be holy for me, because I, the LORD, am holy. I have set you apart from the other nations to belong to me.
A man or a woman who talks with the dead or tells fortunes must be put to death. They must be killed by stoning. Their death is their own fault."
